chunks: And I told them: 'Ask your Lord to forgive you. He is verily forgiving.'
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Noah tell his people to do to attain God's forgiveness?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited as the primary model for communal repentance, highlighting that Noah’s call was not merely verbal but required sincere internal conversion (tawbah) from his people. It underscores the divine attribute of Al-Ghaffar (The All-Forgiving) as the immediate response to sincere seeking, a concept central to the Shia understanding of God's mercy preceding His wrath. This instruction serves as a timeless template for believers to restore their covenant with God through consistent istighfar.
